title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Nature of Underground Hot Water and the Application of Law

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Nature of Underground Thermal Water and the Applicable Laws
May 6, 1996 [1996] Fa Xing Zi No. 5
Higher People's Court of Fujian Province:
Your Court's Request for Instructions on the Nature of Underground Thermal Water and the Applicable Laws (Min Xing Ta Zi No.4 [1995]) has been received. After study and consultation with the Bureau of Legislative Affairs of the State Council, we hereby reply as follows:
Underground thermal water (above 25°C) is a geothermal resource having the dual nature of mineral resources and water resources. The exploration, development, utilization, protection, and management of underground thermal water shall be governed by the Mineral Resources Law of the People's Republic of China, the Implementing Rules for the Mineral Resources Law of the People's Republic of China, and the Provisions on the Administration of the Collection of Mineral Resources Compensation Fees. However, when handling the registration procedures for the extraction of underground thermal water (above 25°C) within urban planning zones according to law, the examination opinions of the competent water administrative department and the competent urban construction administrative department shall be attached.
This is our reply.
